label: PBI report build 2
info: Builds Run_Rates_EU, Volume_CoV_EU and Format_List_EU (site dashboards) from the files in the data lake. No API calls. Needs the Config tab.

name: [1] TRIGGER & TASK SETTINGS
info: STAGE 1 - TRIGGER AND TASK SETTINGS. Builds Run_Rates_EU (Provideam run rates, one row per machine and hour), Volume_CoV_EU (plan OPT rows per day, shift and machine) and Format_List_EU (the Format List file of each site) for the site dashboards. Every row gets Dept, Area, Product Type from the Machine Names file and In EU Report from the report scope file (not Format_List_EU). The inject payload is the job: {"tables": [...], "sites": [...], "from": "YYYY-MM", "to": "YYYY-MM"}, or {"tables", "sites", "days": ["YYYY-MM-DD", ...]} for the day files of the tab Provideam fetch (it sends its job through the link in BACKFILL); a missing list means all, missing months mean last month and this month. Nothing is written while the table is true in DRY_RUN of 1.1.

name: 1.1 TASK SETTINGS (edit here)
1.2 Start jobs
[2] SITE SETUP: MACHINE NAMES
info: STAGE 2 - the Machine Names file of the site (<root>/reference/machine_names/site=<Site>/, newest .csv) is listed, read and parsed, and the lookup MachineName to Dept, Area and Product Type is stored in flow context, for every machine of the file (the EU scope is the column In EU Report, from the report scope file). A machine missing from the file has empty Dept, Area and Product Type. A site without a file stops here and the log says so.

[4] SITE SETUP: FORMAT LIST

A site without a file (Nottingham) gets an empty lookup and goes on: its format columns stay empty.

[5] SITE SETUP: REPORT SCOPE
info: STAGE 5 - the report scope file (<root>/reference/report_scope/site=All/, newest .csv, one row per rule: Site, Tables, Rule keep or drop, Column, Value) is listed, read and parsed, and the rules of the site are stored in flow context. They set the column In EU Report of every table (false: a row the EU pages leave out, the site pages keep). Then the site goes on to the tables of the job.

5.3 Build scope lookup
5.4 Route the site
[6] RUN RATES: MONTHS
info: STAGE 6 - the run rates month files of the site (<root>/pbi_report/source/run_rates/site=<Site>/run_rates_YYYY-MM.csv, made by the normalizer from the Provideam Run Rates exports) are listed and the months of the job that exist are chosen (a missing month is logged and skipped). One message per month, one per second.

6.2 Choose months

info: STAGE 7 - one month of one site: the file is read and parsed and the Run_Rates_EU rows are built as the report queries Run Rates H, N, W do: rows without a machine and rows with Good Parts 0 out, shift name from the Shift Patterns file, Weinheim part code cut, Unique Machine Name, Product Key. Out 2 is a check line.

[15] SITE SETUP: FAILED
info: STAGE 15 - a Machine Names, Shift Patterns, report scope or Format List file that is missing or empty: one log line, nothing is built for that site.

name: 15.1 Describe failure
[16] ERRORS
info: STAGE 16 - a catch node takes every error raised by a node of this tab and turns it into a log line with the name of the node and the message of the API (for example the limit message of evaluateKPIs). Errors of the log nodes themselves are not logged again.

name: 16.1 Describe error
[17] LOG
info: STAGE 17 - every log line arrives here through the link "to LOG". 1 turns a line into a row (time, flow, site, production day, level) and shows it in the debug sidebar. The join collects the rows for 30 s, the delay lets one batch pass every 10 s so two writes do not overlap, 3 sets the file of the month and the read node loads the old file. A read of a file that does not exist answers nothing (only a warning), so the same batch also goes through a 10 s wait to the append step. The log is written whatever the dry-run switch says.

name: 17.1 Format log line
17.2 Note last log line
17.3 Build log write
[18] LOG WRITE
info: STAGE 18 - adds the rows of the batch to the old file and writes the whole file back (the data lake has no append). Columns: ts_utc, seq, flow, site, production_day, mode, level, source, message. Every field is quoted, line breaks become a space. The batch arrives twice (read answer and the wait) and is written once. If the read gives no answer for a file this flow wrote before, a new file with a time stamp is written, so the history is never replaced.

name: 18.1 Append log rows
